title: GET /api/projects/:id/parking-lot — list parking lot items
description: Return all non-archived parking lot items for a project.
acceptanceCriteria: GET requires auth and project ownership
Excludes archived items (archived_at IS NULL) by default
Returns items ordered by created_at DESC

steps.description: Create parking lot router and GET / handler
steps.details: Create server/src/routes/parkingLot.ts with mergeParams: true. GET /: getOwnedProject. Build query WHERE project_id = id. Unless includeArchived=true, add AND archived_at IS NULL. ORDER BY created_at DESC. Return 200 with items.
Create 2 items, archive 1. GET without param — verify 1 returned. GET ?includeArchived=true — verify 2 returned.
